nodes.label: Global State via Zustand
nodes.rationale: No prop-drilling or React Context. No local useState across WebGL/DOM boundary. Use src/core/store.js

nodes.label: The WebGL / DOM Boundary
nodes.rationale: Communicate via zustand. Do not mount DOM elements deeply within 3D scene

nodes.label: Performance & Memory Strictness
nodes.rationale: Avoid imperative new THREE inside render loops. Garbage collect audio. Pre-allocate vectors outside useFrame loop
